task_instruction: Complete each relative clause. Leave the blank empty when an object relative pronoun can be omitted.
paragraphs: A neighborhood cooking club is preparing a shared dinner. The chef {{mask_1}} leads the group starts by washing the vegetables. The carrots {{mask_2}} she bought at the market are set on the counter. A volunteer {{mask_3}} knows how to make fresh pasta measures the flour. The bowl {{mask_4}} the cook uses for the dough is made of wood. The recipe {{mask_5}} the club chose comes from a family cookbook.

The members prepare several dishes together. A baker {{mask_6}} makes excellent bread shows everyone how to shape the rolls. The dough {{mask_7}} he prepared is covered with a clean cloth. A helper {{mask_8}} checks the oven sets the temperature carefully. The baking tray {{mask_9}} the assistant greased is ready for the rolls. The spices {{mask_10}} the cook added give the soup a warm flavor.

While the food cooks, the group prepares a salad and a dessert. The gardener {{mask_11}} grew the tomatoes brings a basket from the community plot. The tomatoes {{mask_12}} she picked that morning are added to the salad. A student {{mask_13}} enjoys trying new recipes cuts the fruit. The cake {{mask_14}} the club is making will be served after dinner. The person {{mask_15}} decorates it uses fresh berries.

When the meal is ready, the volunteers arrange the dishes on long tables. The guests {{mask_16}} arrive early help set out the plates. The tablecloths {{mask_17}} the volunteers spread across the tables are bright blue. A musician {{mask_18}} often plays at local events performs during dinner. The song {{mask_19}} the group requested is a traditional favorite. Everyone thanks the cooks {{mask_20}} prepared the meal together.
